description: Space-Track.org publishes the public satellite catalogue (SATCAT) and orbital element sets for man-made Earth-orbiting objects tracked by the 18th Space Defense Squadron, which analyses Space Surveillance Network data to maintain the catalogue. The GP class lists the newest SGP4 element set for each object, GP_History holds over 138 million historical element sets, and other classes cover decay predictions and conjunction data messages for operators; the typical minimum tracked size is about 10 centimetres. It exists primarily for spaceflight safety, serving satellite owners and operators. Coverage is all publicly releasable objects in Earth orbit since the start of the space age. Data are accessible through a web interface and a REST API that returns OMM in XML or KVN, JSON, CSV, HTML, and the legacy TLE and 3LE formats; a free account is required and the API is throttled to fewer than 30 requests a minute and 300 an hour, with per-class download limits. Caveats: classified objects are omitted, TLE format cannot hold catalogue numbers above 99,999, element sets are approximate and meant for SGP4, and accounts can be suspended for over-use. It serves orbital debris and collision risk, re-entry and satellite infrastructure exposure analysis; related records are the UCS Satellite Database, CelesTrak and DONKI.
